spans.s:
अह् {vI.v} {c1c} A. or {c10c} U. = अंह् q. v.
{vII.v} {c1c} P. To sing together, compose,
celebrate, prepare. {vIII.v} {c5c} P. (अह्नोति,
आहीत्, आह) To pervade. {vIV.v} (a
defective verb preserved only in five
forms आत्थ, आहथुः, आह, आहतुः, आहुः)
1 To say, speak, mention.
--2 To
acknowledge, accept, state.
--3 To
declare, express, signify.
--4 To hold,
consider, regard.
--5 To call.
